title: Tests exercise the store/validation layer, not the HTTP routes
evidence: test/books.test.ts:6 imports createBookStore/validateBook and calls them directly; no test starts the server or hits /health, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /books, despite README.md:37 claiming the tests 'exercise ... the health endpoint'
suggestion: Add at least one integration test that boots createApp() and asserts route status codes (e.g. GET /health 200, POST /books 201, missing id 404)

title: DELETE 204 response sets a content-type header with an empty body
evidence: server.ts:126 calls sendJson(response,204,undefined); sendJson (server.ts:18) always writes 'content-type: application/json' before response.end(JSON.stringify(undefined)) which sends no body
suggestion: Send 204 via response.writeHead(204).end() without a content-type header to match RFC 9110

title: ?author= filter is exact-match only
evidence: server.ts:68 listByAuthor uses 'WHERE author = ?'; TASK.md only requires an ?author= filter and does not specify matching semantics
suggestion: None required; note that partial/case-insensitive matching is not supported if that is later desired
